descriptionChirho: A physical gate or entrance in a city wall, temple, palace, or camp — the concrete architectural opening through which one passes; includes singular and plural forms referring to actual gate structures.

Metonymic use of 'gates' (especially with possessive suffixes) to denote a city, town, or community jurisdiction — as in Deuteronomic law where 'within your gates' means 'within your settlements or territory.'
